messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] log out shiny app server pro when using shinydashboard
parts:
Yves,

If this is Shiny Server Pro, you can open a support ticket. 

Have you configured your Shiny Server to use authentication? In that case you should see a logout button on the app. May be something in your application is hiding it.

To better troubleshoot this, please send us you /etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf file.
Also might help to have your application code, if this is just a UI issue with your code.

Best,
Fereshteh
